questions.question: Which area should I work on next? (Roadmap items 17/18 are actually done — device-secret auth landed in the credential rollout, and content deploy E2E was just verified. These are the genuine remaining gaps.)

options.label: Fix NU1903 package vulnerabilities
options.description: Update Microsoft.OpenApi and System.Security.Cryptography.Xml to patched versions. Quick win, removes high-severity advisories.

options.label: Production compose stack
options.description: Full docker-compose: API + admin web + nginx TLS reverse proxy, not just Postgres/Redis. Enables one-command production deployment.

options.label: Deployment rings / maintenance windows
options.description: Staged rollouts by ring (pilot → broad) with time-window constraints. Builds on the existing scheduling + rollout percent work.

options.label: Signed agent updates + content manifests
options.description: Cryptographic signing of agent update packages and content manifests so agents verify publisher identity, not just file integrity.
